message.Title: Public Preview: New granular controls for network and integration security in Microsoft Foundry

Body.Content:
Microsoft Foundry streamlines AI development and management for the enterprise. We're introducing more granular controls for network and integration security and resource management that empower IT admins to deploy AI solutions while meeting enterprise-grade security, compliance, and governance requirements. 

Bring Your Own (BYO) Storage for Speech and Language in Foundry is in public preview. Link your own Azure Storage account to Speech and Language services in Foundry Tools, for complete control over where and how data is stored, including access policies and retention. 

Learn more.
